units.source_text: 以西美昂为首，包括伞翁在内的，所有在场的人，目睹了如此大祸，

en.t: Beginning with Simeon, and including the old umbrella man, everyone present witnessed this terrible calamity,

units.source_text: 没有不觉得怵目惊心的，都吓得大惊失色。

en.t: and not one of them failed to shudder; all were frightened out of their wits and turned pale.

units.source_text: 这中间伞女嚎啕大哭，突遭雷击，突然从地上跃起，

en.t: Meanwhile the umbrella woman was wailing aloud when, as if struck by lightning, she suddenly sprang up from the ground,

units.source_text: 然后又沮丧的扑倒在地，只看生死不明的幼儿从地方翻滚而来，

en.t: then collapsed helplessly to the ground again, just as the child, whose life or death was unknown, came rolling over from somewhere,

units.source_text: 伞女抱起来幼儿紧紧地搂在怀里。

en.t: and the umbrella woman lifted the child up and clasped it tightly to her breast.

units.source_text: 主的法力无边，主的智慧无边，对主的感谢之情难以言喻。

en.t: The Lord's power is boundless, the Lord's wisdom is boundless, and gratitude to the Lord is beyond words.

units.source_text: 罗连在火梁下面，拼进全力，远远的抛出幼儿到伞女脚下，幼儿竟然安然无恙。

en.t: Under the burning beam, Lorenzo had used every ounce of strength to throw the child far to the umbrella woman's feet, and the child was miraculously unharmed.
